title: DSA & Coding Interview Master Track
description: Comprehensive 22-level curriculum covering all core algorithmic patterns, LeetCode data structures, complexity analysis, and FAANG interview strategies.

levels.title: Complexity Analysis & Foundations
levels.description: Asymptotic notation, Big-O, Big-Ω, Big-Θ, space complexity, and amortized bounds.

topics.description: Calculate time and memory footprints across iterative and recursive algorithms.

levels.title: Arrays & In-Place Algorithms
levels.description: Contiguous memory, Kadane's algorithm, prefix sums, and 2D matrix traversal.

topics.title: Prefix Sums, Subarrays & Kadane's Algorithm

learningItems.title: Prefix sum arrays and range sum queries
Kadane's algorithm for max subarray sum

levels.title: Two Pointers & Sliding Window
levels.description: Two pointers from opposite ends, fast/slow pointers, and dynamic sliding windows.

topics.title: Two Pointers & Sliding Window Invariants

learningItems.title: Opposite direction two pointers on sorted arrays

levels.title: Trees, BST & Heaps

learningItems.title: Recursive DFS (Pre, In, Post) & Level-order BFS
Lowest Common Ancestor and Tree Diameter

levels.title: Graphs, Backtracking & Dynamic Programming
levels.description: Graph BFS/DFS, Topological Sort, Backtracking permutations, and 1D/2D DP.

topics.title: Graph Traversals, Backtracking Pruning & Dynamic Programming
